full_page.content:
1928, February
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 11 Feb. 28 Mrs. Deveraux - 76 Like possessed - Battle Creek
Seleski boys - one 17 with quick consumption, the other 11 also down - the mother has a goiter and finantial trouble.
Rev. Fr. Higgins
Mr. CiCero - poor Cath. - Mrs. C. Christian-cientest - wants to - abortus 4 mo.
James H. Rhody - Rosary - Drinking ... Mrs. Dona Chateau - Mas Baby Herman Hoffand - Mastoids - 3 yrs. Lady in bed in Wakervilla - Cancers Boy 20 - tubercular
Flats to rent Baby in Hospital - $40 needed
Page 12 John Schettenhelm - Cancer of Breast - operated year ago - coming again
Mary Clarkson - now Catherine. Mrs. Soechner - Wyandotte - Heart James Molloy --- + in Seattle Mrs. A. Normandeau - Sick - Head-aches - widow with 5 children hopes to escape operation
Mother whose baby is in Chicago hospital good news - get the $40 To-day.
Page 13 Mrs. M. (Shipway) - Mt Mermod - 6 months almost a year away from Husband wants to get back to Church, etc
